attractions.name: Umngot River (Dawki)
attractions.description: Crystal-clear river near the India–Bangladesh border where boats appear to float on air; one of Meghalaya's most photographed spots.
tips: Boat ride ₹800 – ₹1,500 per boat (shared basis), highly recommended

attractions.name: Khrang Suri Waterfalls
attractions.description: Waterfall with vivid blue water in a forest setting; a short trek leads to a natural pool at the base where swimming is possible.
tips: About 175 steps one way to reach the falls
Carry change of clothes, towels and slippers if entering the water
